name: Wyrd · Evidence Thread
description: Canonical token source for Wyrd's Evidence Thread design system, shared by the documentation site and the workbench. Edit here, then run `node brand/gen-theme.mjs` to regenerate every projection (workbench theme.css, docs wyrd-tokens.css, the wyrd-ui skill theme, and the Wyrd mark renderings). Consumers never restate a value from this file. The human reference is DESIGN.md + ./renders/styleguide.html.

--bg.role: Canvas — the neutral mineral application/page field. Never replaced by an accent, gradient, or neon field.

--surface-2.role: Surface secondary — subordinate regions and neutral controls.

--text.role: Ink — primary text and the strongest rule.

--muted.role: Muted ink — supporting text and metadata.

--border.role: Rule — one-pixel structural dividers and control borders.

--border-soft.role: Rule soft — row and subordinate dividers.

--declare.role: Declare / primary — Declaration identity, links, selection, focus, and the primary action.

--declare-soft.role: Declare soft — selected or contextual declaration field.

--declare-ink.role: Label on a --declare fill (the primary action). Light reuses Surface, dark reuses Canvas.

--observe.role: Observe — observed facts and Observation identity.

--observe-soft.role: Observe soft — selected or contextual observation field.

--evidence.role: Retained Evidence — the retained-evidence signal, the Wyrd mark's center spine, and evidence-capture feedback only. Never a general accent, hover, or wash.

--evidence-ink.role: Label and outline on a --evidence fill. Mode-invariant because --evidence is; light Ink.

--ok.role: Success — successful state; always paired with a glyph or word.

--warn.role: Warning — caution state; always paired with a glyph or word.

--danger.role: Failure — failed judgment or error; always paired with a glyph or word.

--code-bg.role: Code surface — code and terminal blocks (dark in both modes).

--r.role: Radius — restrained two-pixel corners (true circles only for dots/avatars).

$pairs: Contrast contract, asserted by gen-theme.mjs in BOTH modes. Every foreground/background pairing the applications render is declared here so a palette edit that breaks one fails the token gate instead of shipping. `min` is the WCAG floor for the role: 4.5 for text, 3.0 for non-text UI (WCAG 1.4.11), 7.0 where we hold ourselves to AAA. Rule pairs are structural separation and never the sole identifier of a control; see DESIGN.md 'Rules are structure'.

pairs.role: text in subordinate regions and neutral controls
text on a hovered row or control
metadata on a panel; neutral badge label
links, selected refs, focus ring on a panel
text in a selected declaration field
text in a selected observation field
label and outline on a retained-evidence fill
retained-evidence signal on a code/terminal block (non-text)
failure label in a failure context field
text in a failure context field
structural rule on a panel — separation only; controls are also identified by label, fill, or --declare focus
structural rule on canvas — separation only
